explanation: OEIS A368626 (g.f. A(x) = 1 + x(A(x)² − A(−x)²)/2 + x(A(x)³ + A(−x)³)/2), P. D. Hanna's conjecture: a(n) odd iff n = 2^k − 1, even elsewhere. The coefficient extraction uses the odd part of A² and the even part of A³, so [x^n]A uses A² when n is even and A³ when n is odd, which is exactly the formal recurrence; I checked it reproduces the first 12 DATA terms. The statement Odd (a n) ↔ ∃ k, n = 2^k − 1 matches. Faithful.
